key_highlights: ASX wiped out $169B in weekly market value amid escalating recession fears and global tech rotation.
Unemployment jumped to a five-year high, signalling significant labour deterioration and ending RBA rate hike expectations.
Severe residential property correction deepens across Sydney as five rate hikes depress household borrowing capacity.
Retail distress accelerates as David Jones sheds 1,700 jobs while competitor Myer targets poached market share.

sectors.trend: Mounting mortgage stress and credit risk alongside steep Sydney property declines.
sectors.implications: Contracting credit growth and rising loan-loss provisions threaten major bank margins and capital return outlooks.

sectors.trend: Weak currency supports exporter margins while exploration activity concentrates in gold and rare earths.
sectors.implications: AUD weakness provides earnings cushion for unhedged bulk miners; junior gold restarts attract selective equity capital.

sectors.trend: Severe consumer pullback driven by declining real wages and restrictive financial conditions.
sectors.implications: Accelerates structural retail shakeout; Myer stands to capture market share from restructuring competitors like David Jones.

sectors.trend: Domestic supply crunches and scrutiny over large-scale energy infrastructure projects.
sectors.implications: High domestic gas pricing sustains East Coast upstream producer cash flows amid persistent regulatory friction.

sectors.trend: Enterprise AI adoption driving workforce rationalisation and corporate hiring freezes.
sectors.implications: Long-term operating cost reductions for corporate adopters, but near-term headwind for broader domestic white-collar employment.

key_themes: Stagflationary pressures as wage gains fail to outpace inflation while unemployment rises
RBA monetary tightening cycle termination following severe labour market weakening
Accelerating residential property downturn impairing household balance sheets
AUD depreciation enhancing unhedged mining exporter margins while raising import costs

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Macroeconomic Recession and Labour Market Weakness
risk_assessment.mitigation: Rotate equity exposure into defensive, non-cyclical sectors and offshore earners.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing Market Deflation and Mortgage Defaults
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight domestic major banks and residential property developers; implement ASX index put hedges.
Divest cyclical retail exposures and overweight defensive consumer staples.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AUD Depreciation Elevating Imported Cost Pressures
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight unhedged USD resource producers and global healthcare revenue generators.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate USD-earning resource majors on AUD currency weakness
opportunities.rationale: Depreciated AUD expands local currency margins and supports dividend payout sustainability.

opportunities.recommendation: Position for retail market consolidation gains in Myer
opportunities.rationale: David Jones workforce reductions and store pressures create supplier and customer capture opportunity.

opportunities.recommendation: Selectively allocate to near-production gold restarts
opportunities.rationale: Gold provides defensive macro hedging while WA restarts benefit from robust Australian dollar gold pricing.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to major Australian mortgage lenders
defensive_moves.rationale: Surging unemployment and accelerated property declines increase bad debt provisions and curb credit demand.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Increase portfolio cash and index-level defensive overlays
defensive_moves.rationale: Mitigate portfolio volatility following a $169B market decline and mounting domestic recession risks.

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish over 1–3 months as the ASX 200 digests heavy weekly losses, deteriorating unemployment data, and property sector weakness.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously neutral over 6–12 months, anticipating eventual RBA policy easing to stabilise household balance sheets and floor asset valuations.
key_catalysts: RBA monetary policy pivot and prospective rate cut signalling
Australian Bureau of Statistics quarterly CPI and monthly employment updates
Major bank interim trading updates and mortgage impairment reporting
Global commodity demand trends and AUD/USD currency stabilisation
watch_list: RBA cash rate expectations and 3-year Australian Government Bond yields
Sydney and Melbourne residential property auction clearance rates and price indices
ASX 200 financial vs materials sector performance divergence
